tools.name: search_contractors
tools.description: Search active contractors by trade, place (ZIP, city, state or province), company name or service words, and geo radius. Uses the same matching, ranking (distance, Bayesian rating, review count, profile completeness) and duplicate merging as contractorsnearme.ai/search. is_verified is true only when the contractor's license passed a check against a state board record.

tools.name: get_contractor
tools.description: Get detailed contractor profile by slug. Returns full profile including about text, website, and trade details. The website is null when none is stored or when the stored value is not the business's own site (a directory, social or government page). Phone and email are returned only to callers with an API key; without one they are null and contact_details is requires_api_key. A customer key gets the phone but not the email (contact_details is phone_only). is_verified is true only when the contractor's license passed a check against a state board record.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Get reviews for a contractor by slug. Returns review text, rating, reviewer name, and dates. Limited to 50 per request.

tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: Get a list of all available trades/professions. Returns filtered list of contractor trades from the directory.

tools.name: search_itbs
tools.description: Search public invitations to bid (ITBs) on the projects board. Returns open project title, description, budget range, location, and created date. Public read, no API key required.

tools.name: get_itb
tools.description: Get a single public invitation to bid (ITB) by its UUID. Returns full project detail including description, budget range, job site address, and dates. Public read, no API key required.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Get a contractor's published availability calendar by slug. Returns days, start/end times, timezone, and note. Public read, no API key required.

tools.name: list_marketplace_requests
tools.description: List public marketplace requests with canonical request status, bounded budget visibility, urgency, payment summary, and proposal/application summary fields.

tools.name: get_marketplace_request
tools.description: Get a single public marketplace request by UUID or slug, with canonical request status, bounded budget visibility, payment summary, and proposal/application summary fields.

tools.name: get_badge_snippet
tools.description: Build the HTML for a contractor's free Contractors Near Me badge, an image that links to their profile for their own website. The badge says Verified license only when the profile's license passed a check against a state board record; every other profile gets the neutral badge, which carries only the Contractors Near Me name.
